entries.headline: Nvidia tells server partners to pause shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as US tightens export controls
entries.summary: Nvidia told manufacturing partners such as Dell and Supermicro to halt server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries. The pause follows a new US rule requiring licenses for advanced AI chip purchases there and a closed remote-access loophole.
evidence: FT, NYT, WSJ, TechCrunch, Reuters, Forbes

entries.headline: Sources say leading AI labs hold unreleased algorithmic breakthroughs that could break deployed cryptosystems; Bank of England's Bailey voices concern
entries.summary: Scott Aaronson's post reports that leading labs are sitting on major unreleased breakthroughs whose exact nature is unknown. Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey said unreleased AI models have raised encryption concerns and called for global model testing.

entries.headline: Anthropic shares slide after IPO, trading as ANT, with tech stocks hit as investors rotate
entries.summary: Anthropic entered the public market and is down about 7% since its IPO. WSJ reports investors dumping AI stocks to buy into Anthropic lowered tech shares; S&P 500 inclusion is not imminent.

entries.headline: Jensen Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia sparks governance scrutiny, S&P downgrade warning and divided Washington
entries.summary: Huang returned to Nvidia after White House involvement. S&P is considering a downgrade over governance and key-man risk, Moody's leaves ratings unchanged, and US officials are divided over Chinese spying allegations.

entries.headline: US chip curbs and distillation crackdown threaten Chinese AI model development; Z.ai's GLM-5.5 reportedly delayed
entries.summary: Reuters sources say Z.ai's flagship GLM-5.5 missed its November release and could slip to Q1 2027 or later. Moonshot AI expects longer intervals between major releases.

entries.headline: SAP prepares at least 10,000 job cuts in AI-era restructuring
entries.summary: SAP is planning to cut at least 9% of staff to transform its software business for AI.

entries.headline: FCC approves SpaceX plan for up to one million data-center satellites
entries.summary: US regulators authorised Musk's Starmind constellation for space AI computing; scientists are skeptical.

entries.headline: Microsoft says China and North Korea state hackers use AI pentest tool ARTEX
entries.summary: Groups including Salt Typhoon have added the AI tool to their attacks.

entries.headline: OpenAI corrects GPT-6.2 billing bug; Astra users will hit usage limits 40% faster
entries.summary: OpenAI admitted a billing mistake that incorrectly discounted usage for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launches.

entries.headline: ASML CEO and Dutch government push back on proposed US export curbs
entries.summary: Fouquet warns against cutting China off, and the Netherlands will resist the proposed curbs and ask Washington not to enforce the MATCH Act.

entries.headline: Reports probe China ties of US-based Nvidia buyers and partners as chip loophole closes
entries.summary: Chinese-owned California firms are buying advanced Nvidia chips, and buyers are told to rule out Chinese renters.

entries.headline: Trump to lead December 4 groundbreaking for TSMC Arizona expansion
entries.summary: Trump will lead the ceremony for expansion of TSMC's Phoenix chip plant, days after bringing Jensen Huang back to Nvidia.

entries.headline: AI leaders push back on Anthropic vision; OpenAI and Anthropic researchers warn new models may be too powerful to release
entries.summary: Axios reports rivals disputing Anthropic's vision, Amodei pushing back on free-will reporting, and warnings about unsafe-to-release models.

entries.headline: AI safety rules move in states: Hochul vetoes AI safety bill, California governor seeks action, NY AG forms RAISE Act unit
entries.summary: State-level AI safety bills and enforcement are in motion, and Democrats demand new restrictions.

entries.headline: MiniMax data accessed by unidentified parties; Apple pulls MiniMax chatbot over child safety
entries.summary: A researcher says MiniMax data was accessed, and Apple removed its chatbot from the App Store.

entries.headline: Meta refused UK FCA joint testing of its Muse personal AI agent
entries.summary: The FCA complained that Meta declined to work on testing before rolling out its agent.

entries.headline: AI bubble worries: BoE flags AI borrowing risks, SoftBank default fears, volatile AI stocks
entries.summary: Markets and regulators weigh AI financial risk; Aschenbrenner's fund and VC secondaries also in focus.

entries.headline: Memory chip shortage sparks procurement war rooms, with some prices up 10x
entries.summary: The global shortage is raising electronics prices.

entries.headline: ElevenLabs in talks for new funding at $33B valuation
entries.summary: The voice AI startup is reportedly seeking funding.

entries.headline: 42 state AGs try to stop Character.AI from selling user chats in bankruptcy
entries.summary: A coalition of attorneys general opposes sale of user data in Chapter 11.

entries.headline: Data center backlash grows over power costs; Texas resumes permitting
entries.summary: Opposition in the US and Japan, plus Fitch on Asia investment slowdown under chip curbs.

entries.headline: AI agents used in five Swiss cyberattacks; undisclosed AI use hits dozens of English court cases
entries.summary: Swiss government reports agent-driven attacks, and the Guardian finds at least 25 affected cases.

entries.headline: Anthropic's Claude lets users turn artifacts into apps
entries.summary: New Claude feature.

entries.headline: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares per year for every US child via Trump Accounts, worth about $18B
entries.summary: Musk and SpaceX will double the pledge via Trump Accounts.

entries.headline: Avicena raises $100M+ Series C for microLED AI chip interconnects
entries.summary: SK Hynix, Samsung and AMD ventures joined the round led by Intervest.

entries.headline: New regional models: BharatGen Patram 1.5, Sber GigaChat 4, Amini Soma
entries.summary: BharatGen launched a 7B document model; Sber introduced agentic GigaChat 4.

entries.headline: Thariq Shihipar joins OpenAI from Anthropic
entries.summary: He left Anthropic in October and announced the move on X.

entries.headline: Holidays to test AI shopping bots from Google, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI
entries.summary: Bloomberg on competing shopping assistants.

entries.headline: Anthropic built honeypot to test whether AI agents break out
entries.summary: Malwarebytes reports on the experiment.

entries.headline: Former Pentagon official Caroline Zier now leads OpenAI's military AI limits
entries.summary: Broadband Breakfast reports Zier's role at OpenAI.
